title: Lab 3 - Exploring pipeline configuration, part 2
description: Variables, rules, workflow, schedules, resource groups and a matrix.
scenario: The KodeKloud 'Exploring Pipeline Configuration Part-2' lab: every decision keyword from week 3 on one pipeline, run from a push, a merge request and a schedule.
environment_setup:
# A gitlab.com account (free tier is enough) with shared runners enabled on the project,
# git on your machine, and a terminal. Keep Build → Pipelines open in a second tab.
git --version
git remote -v
cleanup: # Nothing to clean: pipelines and jobs are history. Delete the scratch project when the track is over.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Variables and precedence
tasks.instructions: Define TARGET globally, override it in one job, add a project variable TARGET in the UI, and print it from two jobs. Predict each value before running.
tasks.verification: show-global prints staging (YAML beats project), show-job prints production.

tasks.title: Task 2 - File variable and masking
tasks.instructions: Create a masked variable API_TOKEN and a File variable KUBE_CFG; echo both and cat the file path.
tasks.verification: Log shows [MASKED] for the token and a /builds/…tmp path for the file variable.

tasks.title: Task 3 - workflow and rules
tasks.instructions: Add workflow:rules for MR / main / tags (no branch pipeline when an MR is open); make unit-tests run on MRs and main, deploy only on tags with when: manual + allow_failure: false. Open an MR and push again.
tasks.solution:
workflow:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH && $CI_OPEN_MERGE_REQUESTS
      when: never
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG
tasks.verification: Exactly one pipeline per push on the MR; a tag pipeline stops at the manual deploy.

tasks.title: Task 4 - Schedule, resource group, matrix
tasks.instructions: Create a nightly schedule; add a job that runs only from it; give deploy resource_group: staging; add a build matrix OS × ARCH.
tasks.solution:
nightly: {script: ["echo night"], rules: [{if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule"}]}
build: {script: ["echo $OS-$ARCH"], parallel: {matrix: [{OS: [linux, darwin], ARCH: [amd64, arm64]}]}}
tasks.verification: Play the schedule: only nightly runs; the matrix creates 4 jobs named build: [linux, amd64] etc.
